description: This file defines an Android Fragment class named ItemAddFragment that provides a user interface dialog for adding restrictions items with key-value pairs. It includes UI event handling, interaction with parent components, and input validation.

classes.name: ItemAddFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment that provides an interface for adding a key-value item, validating input, and notifying a listener upon addition.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to the context and initializes the listener to either the parent fragment or context.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Detaches the listener from the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and inflates the view for the dialog, setting the title.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI elements after the view is created and sets click listener.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events, specifically the OK button to add an item.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Validates user input and calls the listener with the key-value pair if valid.
